data.summary: Two unknowns need two equations (elimination or substitution). Quadratics need factorising, the formula, or completing the square, and context may reject some roots.
key_concepts: Elimination when coefficients can be matched; substitution when one variable is already isolated
A quadratic must be in the form ax^2 + bx + c = 0 before solving
In applications, reject roots that are impossible (e.g. negative rates or distances)

formulas.label: Quadratic formula
formulas.note: For ax^2 + bx + c = 0 with a != 0.

worked_examples.question: Solve 3x^2 - 30x - 5000 = 0 to 2 d.p. (pump rate; reject impossible roots).

common_mistakes.mistake: Trying to factorise a quadratic that has not been rearranged to equal zero.
common_mistakes.fix: Move every term to one side so the equation reads ... = 0 first.

common_mistakes.mistake: Giving only one solution to a quadratic.
common_mistakes.fix: State both roots, then reject any that fail the context check.

exam_tips: If answers are needed to 2 decimal places, use the quadratic formula.
Substitute both answers back into an original equation to check.
